# Roof Framing Calculator

Calculate roof framing parameters including run, gable height, gable area, and roof slope.

![Roof framing diagram](static/docs/documents/1715/roof_framing.png)

## Formulas

**Run:** R = S / 2

**Gable Height:** GH = R × VR

**Gable Area:** GA = GH × R

**Roof Slope:** RS = y / x

where:
- R = run (ft)
- S = span (ft)
- GH = gable height (ft)
- VR = vertical rise (in/ft)
- GA = gable area (sq.ft)
- RS = roof slope
